1.c4 g6 2.d4 Bg7 3.Nc3 c5 4.d5 d6 5.e4.strategy: Builds the full pawn centre with c4, d5 and e4, giving White a big space advantage. Black cannot easily drive the pawns back and must undermine them with the g7 bishop and flank pawn breaks, while White must keep the c3 knight supported.

1.c4 g6 2.d4 Bg7 3.Nc3 c5 4.d5 d6 5.e4 Q.strategy: Pins the c3 knight against the king and attacks it twice with the bishop, so White must unpin at the cost of time. Black stays flexible, though the queen is exposed to harassment.
1.c4 g6 2.d4 Bg7 3.Nc3 c5 4.d5 d6 5.e4 Q.name: Pterodactyl Defence: Central, Benoni Quetzalcoatlus

1.c4 g6 2.d4 Bg7 3.Nc3 c5 4.d5 d6 5.e4 B.strategy: Removes the knight at the price of the fianchettoed bishop. White's c-pawns are doubled but a big centre and the two bishops are the compensation; Black must go after the weak pawns.
